description:
When you need to traverse the mountains, commute in the city, ride, you can choose Eurobike's mountain bike, it is suitable for mountain roads, dirt roads, road, cycling trails.

21-speed trigger shifters and front and rear derailleurs make gear changes easy and smooth

Front and rear mechanical disc brakes provide clear all-condition, stopping on the trail; durable alloy cranks provide stable gearing and less maintenance hassle

It has a frame size of 19" and a wheel size of 29", suitable heights: 5'4"-6'2", and a maximum load capacity of 330 lbs

Product description

X3 29” mountain bike

Eurobike's mountain bikes feature premium carbon steel frames and alloy wheels. This bike is great for paved areas, including road trips and community riding, and it's also a great choice for your daily commute.

Disc brake

Mechanical disc brakes provide powerful stopping power to stop you on any road

29*2.10 tires

29*2.10 thickened and widened mountain bike tires provide strong off-road capability.

Shimano TZ30/Shimano TZ50

The front and rear derailleurs are ShimanoTZ30/ShimanoTZ50 respectively, providing precise shifting

Shimano 21(3*7gears) speeds

Shift lever EF500, the shifting system adopts Shimano's shift kit Shimano shift lever.
